title: Replace a lost, stolen or destroyed NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card
summary: You can replace a lost, stolen, or destroyed NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card online, or by calling or visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If your NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card has been lost, stolen or destroyed, you can replace it online.

If you're unable to replace your card online, call us on 13 77 88 or visit a Service NSW Centre.
what_you_need: The 'Seniors/Senior Savers Card' service added to your MyServiceNSW Account
Your Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card number (optional)

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to replace your card.

more_info.text: If you wish, you can get a digital version of the Seniors/Senior Savers Card through the Service NSW app.

faqs.q: How can I replace my NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card?
faqs.a: You can replace your card online, or call 13 77 88 or visit a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What do I need to replace my card online?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, the 'Seniors/Senior Savers Card' service added to your account, your personal details, and your card number (though you can still order a replacement without it).

faqs.q: What are the steps to replace my card online?
faqs.a: Select the 'Replace online' button, log in or create your MyServiceNSW Account, and follow the prompts to replace your card.
